# Lesser, Landy, Smith & Siegel, PLLC

> A Florida-based personal injury law firm specializing in accident claims, medical malpractice, and wrongful death litigation with offices in West Palm Beach, Boca Raton, and Stuart.

Lesser, Landy, Smith & Siegel, PLLC has been serving Florida clients since 1927, building a reputation for trial expertise and significant case results. The firm's attorneys are recognized by Martindale-Hubbell and The Florida Bar, with deep experience in personal injury law, PIP insurance disputes, and catastrophic injury cases.
